name: Self-Disclosure Analysis
description: Classify self-disclosure in human-AI conversations across 5 dimensions: Level, Confession, Depth, Intimacy, and a hierarchical Topic taxonomy.

dimensions.name: Level of disclosure

labels.name: High
labels.definition: Include personal, sensitive, or emotionally vulnerable content (Zhang et al. 2025). Share extensively their personal beliefs and fear, for instance, their vital constructs and private, sensitive informational attributes. Associated with vulnerable and self-loathing thoughts (e.g. thoughts of suicide), bear a negative tone, or depict confessional experience (Balani & de Choudhury, 2015).

labels.name: Low
labels.definition: Mention the user without sensitive content (Zhang et al. 2025).

labels.name: No
labels.definition: Do not mention the user at all (Zhang et al. 2025). About people or things other than the author, and which divulged information unrelated to the self (Balani & de Choudhury, 2015).

dimensions.instructions: Very restrictive 'No' — only for truly empty agreements/generic reactions with zero personal content. Sharing preferences, experiences, or opinions is at least Low.

dimensions.name: Disclosure as confession

labels.name: Yes, it's a confession
labels.definition: Revealing personal info about the self, telling something about the person, describing the person in some way, or referring to the person's experiences, thoughts or feelings (Croes et al., 2024).

labels.name: No, it's not a confession
labels.definition: None of the above (Croes et al., 2024).

dimensions.instructions: Broader than just revealing hidden burdens — includes shame/stigma-adjacent admissions.

dimensions.name: Depth of disclosure

labels.name: Peripheral
labels.definition: Superficial information, such as a person's age, place of residence or professional interests (Altman & Taylor, 1973, as cited in Skjuve et al., 2023).

labels.name: Intermediate
labels.definition: Sharing of opinions or attitudes, such as political views (Altman & Taylor, 1973, as cited in Skjuve et al., 2023).

labels.name: Central
labels.definition: Information about one's self-worth, feelings, needs, values and, at its core, defining personal characteristics (Altman & Taylor, 1973, as cited in Skjuve et al., 2023).

dimensions.instructions: Key distinction: CURRENTLY EXPERIENCED vs REFLECTING from distance. Factual condition reports are Intermediate, not Central.

dimensions.name: Intimacy of self-disclosure

labels.name: Peripheral
labels.definition: Biographical information (e.g., age, gender, height, and other basic info) (Croes et al., 2024).

labels.name: Intermediate
labels.definition: Opinions, attitudes, and values (Croes et al., 2024).

labels.name: Core
labels.definition: Personal beliefs, fears, emotions and things people are ashamed of (Croes et al., 2024).

dimensions.instructions: SHOWING vs TELLING distinction. Brief direct emotional wounds are Core (SHOWING). Narrating events with emotions is Intermediate (TELLING).

dimensions.name: Topic

labels.name: Causal conversation
labels.definition: Everyday small talk and casual updates about daily activities.

labels.name: Interpersonal issues
labels.definition: Relationships, conflicts, or social dynamics with other people.

labels.name: Entertainment
labels.definition: Lighthearted topics for fun or amusement (games, media, jokes).

labels.name: Emotional response
labels.definition: Expressing feelings or reactions to events or interactions.

labels.name: Current life challenges
labels.definition: Ongoing difficulties or stressors in the user's present life.

labels.name: Desire for friendship
labels.definition: Seeking companionship, connection, or social belonging.

labels.name: Work stress
labels.definition: Pressure, demands, or difficulties related to work.

labels.name: Emotional distress
labels.definition: Acute negative emotional states such as anxiety, sadness, or anguish.

labels.name: Mental health discussion
labels.definition: Mental-health conditions, therapy, or psychological wellbeing.

labels.name: Information and advice
labels.definition: Seeking facts, guidance, or recommendations on a topic.

labels.name: Future plans
labels.definition: Discussing intentions, goals, or upcoming events.

labels.name: Philosophical perspective
labels.definition: Reflective or abstract discussion of meaning, values, or worldview.

labels.name: Intimate exchange
labels.definition: Romantic or sexually intimate interaction with the AI.

labels.name: Desire for romantic connection
labels.definition: Expressing longing for romance, love, or a partner.

dimensions.instructions: Hierarchical: each topic (leaf) rolls up into a thematic category (its path). Pick the single most fitting topic for the main subject of the message.
